Amounts are integer USD cents. Related contracts, balances, payment schedules and counterparty records are available through service_cases and service_records. Queries and request preparation do not advance time. Instructions use case_id, action and data. The customer approves the exact pending instruction through the customer portal; the assistant executes that approved request. Preparation and approval do not move money. Re-executing the same request does not duplicate a transaction; a separately submitted instruction does.

The pay action uses {record_id: finance bill ID, amount_minor: positive integer}. Payments are final and may be partial; the service accepts instructions subject to available free cash, including instructions that overpay a bill. Each bill states its gross contractual amount and inclusive due_minute. A supplier credit offsets only its named bill. Locked margins and controlled collections are not free cash. Historical capital and payments are already reflected in opening balances. There is no funding, reversal or substitute counterparty beyond the recorded facilities and listed actions. Record one COMPLETED outcome after servicing is concluded.

Borrowing base retirement: concentration and quality credits — revision 12.1

The replacement borrowing base is calculated by debtor. Sum remaining receivable face times advance_bp/10000 for each debtor, cap the debtor subtotal at debtor_cap_minor, add those capped subtotals, then deduct the actual reserve, floored at zero. Collected and sold face no longer supports the facility. NEW drawings are available only through draw_close_minute and each new draw must remain within the current borrowing base. Repayment after that window does not reopen availability. There is no later rollover or additional commitment.

OLD is an independent loan. Cash repayments reduce only the named loan. OLD may draw its recorded unused option, but any draw applies redraw_lock_minute even if the principal is immediately repaid. Retirement requires zero debt and current time at or after lock_through_minute. Completed retirement releases that contract's lien. The retirement deadline is recorded on OLD; NEW does not inherit the lock or lien. Repayment and actual retirement are separate services.

At minute zero an available receivable sale transfers exactly sale_minor face for sale_price_minor cash. The sale is final and reduces both eligible face and the later collection belonging to this customer. At minute two each debtor pays collection_minor less any sold portion into that debtor's controlled balance, and remaining face falls by the collected amount. The same quality certificate publishes its actual reserve from possible_reserves_minor. It also establishes a supplier quality credit of the same face amount: the certificate measures inventory defects supporting both the lender's reserve and the supplier's price concession. These are distinct legal effects of the same finding. CREDIT identifies the only invoice to which that concession may be applied. The gross invoice amount remains unchanged. A credit is not cash, cannot pay tax, and cannot be assigned to another bill. It may be applied once or in parts up to the amount actually received.

The replacement loan must satisfy its final borrowing base by covenant_due_minute. A temporary excess arising at the certificate event may be cured before that inclusive deadline. apply_collection sends a specified debtor's controlled proceeds directly to NEW principal; it cannot settle OLD or any invoice. release_collection credits free cash. The first release for a debtor incurs that debtor's release_fee_minor once; application directly to NEW has no release fee. Parts of a receipt may be applied and released. Applied and released portions are distinct, and no controlled money remains available after either operation. Remaining face does not increase if cash is later repaid from the wallet.

Unlock propose_finance_borrowing. draw and repay_cash use {record_id: borrowing line ID, amount_minor}; retire_old uses {}; sell_receivable uses {record_id: borrowing receivable ID}; apply_collection and release_collection use {record_id: borrowing receivable ID, amount_minor}. apply_supplier_credit uses {record_id: supplier credit ID, bill_record_id: finance bill ID, amount_minor}. pay uses the common schema.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_finance_borrowing`

Prepare a facility draw or repayment, legacy retirement, receivable sale, debtor-source collection application or release, supplier credit application, or inventory payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
